name: Send Fernhill Supplies invoice email
summary: When a new invoice row is added, the agent emails the customer with the invoice details. It runs immediately for each newly created row.

email.subject: Invoice {{row.invoice_id}} from Fernhill Supplies
email.body:
Dear {{row.customer}},

Attached is invoice {{row.invoice_id}} ({{money(row.amount)}}). Payment is due by {{format_date(row.due_date)}}.

Please include the invoice number as your payment reference.

Best,
Fernhill Supplies Accounts

source.workflow: add a row to invoices + send 'Fernhill Supplies invoice <id>'
notes: No column values are updated after the row is created.
The rule fires for every new row; no additional conditions are needed.
